verses.gurmukhi: ੨੦ : ਕੂੜ ਦਾ ਅੰਤ ਬੁਰਾ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ
verses.translit_en: 20 : kooR dhaa a(n)t buraa hu(n)dhaa hai

en.bdb: The end of the falsehood is very bad

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਮਜੀਠ ਦਾ ਸਹੈ ਅਵਟਣ ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜ੍ਹਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: sach subhaau majeeTh dhaa sahai avaTan ra(n)g chaRhaae|

en.bdb: The nature of truth is like madder which itself bears the heat of boiling but makes the dye fast.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਣ ਜਿਉ ਕੂੜੁ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਹੈ ਖਲ ਕਢਾਇ ਵਟਾਇ ਬਨਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: san jiau kooR subhaau hai khal kaddai vaTai banaae|

en.bdb: The nature of falsehood is like that of jute whose skin is peeled off and then twisting it, its ropes are prepared.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੰਨਣ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਕਰਿ ਅਫਲ ਸਫਲ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਵਸਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: cha(n)nan paraupakaar kar afal safal vich vaas vasaae|

en.bdb: Sandal being benevolent makes all the trees, be they with or without fruits, fragrant.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਡਾ ਵਿਕਾਰੀ ਵਾਂਸੁ ਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਲੈ ਗਵਾਂਢੁ ਜਲਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: vaddaa vikaaree vaa(n)s hai haumai jalai gavaa(n)dd jalaae|

en.bdb: Bamboo being full of evil, bums in its own ego and at the out break of fire, bums its other neighbourly trees also.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਾਣ ਅਮਿਓ ਰਸੁ ਕਾਲਕੂਟੁ ਖਾਧੈ ਮਰੈ ਮੁਏ ਜੀਵਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: jaan amio ras kaalakooT khaadhai marai mue jeevaae|

en.bdb: The nectar makes the dead alive and deadly poison kills the living.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦਰਗਹ ਸਚੁ ਕਬੂਲੁ ਹੈ ਕੂੜਹੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: dharageh sach kabool hai kooRahu dharageh milai sajaae|

en.bdb: Truth is accepted in the court of the Lord, but, the falshood is punished in the same court.
